title: Same layout, more water
hook: Which load needs more model steps at the same rate?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: If the removal rate is fixed, twice as much water takes twice as many model steps. Spreading the cloth and reducing retained water address different parts of the same equation.
